# ExceptNode

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Query.Planning.Nodes.ExceptNode`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Query`

## Summary

Implements the EXCEPT set operation: returns rows from the left child that do not appear in the right child. Deduplicates output (set semantics).
